title: AlpineAi Library Document Metadata
description: Schema for a single document record in the AlpineAi Library index.

relative_path.description: Path to the PDF relative to the configured source directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the PDF file contents.

intake_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the file was added to the intake queue.

title.description: Document title extracted from PDF metadata.

page_count.description: Number of pages in the document.

extraction_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when metadata was extracted.

review_flags.description: Flags raised during the review stage.

status.description: Current pipeline stage of this record.

quality_score.description: Automated quality score (0–100) assigned in Stage 5.
